armySpecialRules.name: Clan Enmity
armySpecialRules.description:
Units belonging to each of the Greater Clans (Pestilens,
Eshin, Moulder, Skryre) may only be joined by
characters from the same Clan.

armySpecialRules.name: Life Is Cheap
armySpecialRules.description:
All Skaven models can voluntarily target ranged
attacks at enemy units engaged in close combat with
other friendly units even if they are further than 4"
away. However, if they do so, they will hit their own
troops on To Hit rolls of both 1's and 2's rather than just
1's. In addition, the normal limitation of templates not
being allowed to be placed over friendly troops does
not apply.

armySpecialRules.name: Scurry Away
armySpecialRules.description:
All models in the Skaven army roll an additional D6
and discard the lowest result when determining their
flee distance.

armySpecialRules.name: Strength In Numbers
armySpecialRules.description:
Units with this special rule add +1 to its Leadership if it
has Unit Strength 10 or more, +2 Leadership if it has
Unit Strength 15 or more, and +3 Leadership if it has
Unit Strength 20 or more. To calculate the Leadership
of a unit with the Strength in Numbers rule, first
determine the unit's Leadership as normal and then add
the Leadership bonus of the unit to this value, up to a
maximum Leadership of 10.
Note that a Skaven General confers his basic
Leadership and then units modify it with their own
Unit Strength. Any bonus from the Unit Strength of the
General's unit is not passed on to units within his
Inspiring Presence range.

armySpecialRules.name: Unstable Ammunition
armySpecialRules.description:
Anytime a weapon that uses Unstable Ammunition
scores a result of 1 on its roll To Hit, roll another dice.
On a following roll of 1-2 the gun misfires and the
shooter suffers the hit themselves.

armySpecialRules.name: Verminous Valour
armySpecialRules.description:
If a Skaven player refuses a challenge, a Skaven
character is placed in the back rank of the unit and may
not attack, but the unit may still use the model's
Leadership value, Inspiring Presence or Hold Your
Ground special rules.

magicItems.name: Fellblade
magicItems.description:
Warlord only. This foul sword gives the bearer Strength
10 and the Multiple Wounds (D6) special rule, and
successful ward saves taken against wounds inflicted
by the bearer in close combat must be re-rolled. Roll a
D6 at the end of each of the wielder's turns; on a 3+
there is no effect. On a roll of 1-2 the wielder suffers 1
wound with no armour save allowed.

magicItems.name: Electro-Whip
magicItems.description:
Clan Moulder only. Whip. An Electro-whip gives the
wielder +D3 Attacks rather than 1 as well as the
Lightning Attacks special rule.

magicItems.name: Dwarf Slayer
magicItems.description:
All attacks made with this weapon are resolved at +1
Strength and have the Multiple Wounds (2) special
rule. Against all models from Warhammer: Dwarfs, all
hits have the Armour Piercing (1) special rule and the
wielder may re-roll all failed rolls To Wound.

magicItems.name: Desolate Blade
magicItems.description:
The Desolate Blade gives the wielder +1 Strength and
allows them to re-roll all failed rolls To Wound.

magicItems.name: The Fumigatous
magicItems.description:
Clan Pestilens only. Plague Censer. All Toughness tests
taken from this weapon suffer a -1 modifier.

magicItems.name: Languisher Sword
magicItems.description:
The Languisher Sword causes all enemy models in
base contact with the wielder to be subject to the
Always Strikes Last special rule.

magicItems.name: The Three Fangs
magicItems.description:
Two hand weapons & tail weapon. If the wielder of
these weapons scores 3 or more Hits against a single
model, all those hits automatically Wound with the
Ignores Armour Saves special rule.

magicItems.name: Cursed Blade Of Delirium
magicItems.description:
The Cursed Blade of Delirium causes all enemy
models attempting to strike the wielder in close combat
to suffer -1 To Hit.

magicItems.name: Headsplitter
magicItems.description:
Clan Eshin only. Sling. Against models with Toughness
5+, Headsplitter automatically Wounds on the roll of a
2+ with the Ignores Armour Saves special rule.

magicItems.name: Snap-Snap Snarepole
magicItems.description:
Clan Moulder only. Things-catcher. One enemy model
of your choice suffer a -1 penalty to their Attacks.

magicItems.name: Blade Of Black Fury
magicItems.description:
The Blade of Black Fury gives the wielder +2 Initiative
and +1 Attack.

magicItems.name: Gnawshard
magicItems.description:
Any character, Monstrous Creature or Monster that
suffers one or more unsaved Wounds from this weapon
must pass a Toughness test at the start of each
subsequent close combat phase for the rest of the game,
or suffer one Wound with no saves allowed.

magicItems.name: Things-Bane
magicItems.description:
This weapon gives the bearer the Multiple Wounds (2)
special rule.

magicItems.name: Brooding Blade
magicItems.description:
Any model that suffers one or more unsaved Wounds
from this weapon suffers 2D6 Strength 1 Hits with no
saves allowed at the end of that round of close combat.

magicItems.name: Lash Of Fangs
magicItems.description:
Clan Moulder only. Whip. Any character, Monstrous
Creature or Monster that suffers one or more unsaved
Wounds from this weapon are subject to the Stupidity
special rule for the remainder of the game.

magicItems.name: Warpforged Blade
magicItems.description:
Clan Skryre only. A Warpforged Blade gives the
wielder the Ignores Armour Saves special rule.

magicItems.name: Foulhide
magicItems.description:
Medium armour. This armour gives the wearer the
Regeneration (4+) special rule.

magicItems.name: Shield Of Distraction
magicItems.description:
Shield. The Shield of Distraction causes all enemies in
base contact with the bearer to suffer -1 Attack.

magicItems.name: Rust Armour
magicItems.description:
Medium armour. The first time the wearer is wounded
by a Strength high enough to completely cancel his
armour save, or is not permitted an armour save for any
reason, the Wound is discounted, but the armour is
completely destroyed.

magicItems.name: Warpstone Amulet
magicItems.description:
The Amulet confers to the bearer a 4+ Ward save. At
the end of each of your turns, roll a D6. On the result of
1, the character suffers a Wound with no saves allowed.

magicItems.name: Tenebrous Cloak
magicItems.description:
The Tenebrous Cloak gives the wearer a 3+ Ward save
against all missile attacks and spells.

magicItems.name: Twisted Crown Of The Horned Rat
magicItems.description:
The Twisted Crown of the Horned Rat gives the wearer
the Regeneration (4+) special rule.

magicItems.name: Rival Hide Talisman
magicItems.description:
The Rival Hide Talisman forces all enemies attempting
to strike the wearer in close combat to re-roll
successful rolls To Hit.

magicItems.name: Shadow Magnet Trinket
magicItems.description:
All missile attacks targeted at the bearer of the Shadow
Magnet Trinket or the unit they are with suffer -1 To
Hit.

magicItems.name: Suspicious Stone
magicItems.description:
This item gives the wearer a 6+ Ward save which may
be re-rolled.

magicItems.name: Warpscale Pendant
magicItems.description:
The Warpscale Pendant gives the bearer the Immunity
(Flaming Attacks, Lightning Attacks) and Magic
Resistance (2) special rules. However, at the beginning
of the game, the bearer must pass a Toughness test or
suffer a Wound with no saves allowed.

magicItems.name: Amulet Of Darkness
magicItems.description:
The Amulet of Darkness gives the wearer the Magical
Resistance (1) special rule. In addition, if a spell or
magic item that would normally force the wearer and
any unit they are with to reveal any Magic Items or
Hidden models, they only need to reveal the Amulet of
Darkness.

magicItems.name: Staff Of Rightful Supremacy
magicItems.description:
All enemy Wizards within 12" of the bearer of this item
suffer a -1 casting penalty. In addition, if the bearer's
dispel roll result is 13, the spell is automatically
dispelled.

magicItems.name: Warpscroll
magicItems.description:
One use only. Bound spell, Power Level 6. The
Warpscroll contains a direct damage spell with a range
of 24". It inflicts a Strength 3 Hit on all models in the
unit. If the unit suffers any casualties from the spell,
they must also take a Panic test.

magicItems.name: Warpstorm Scroll
magicItems.description:
Bound Spell, Power Level 5. One use only. The
Warpstorm Scroll contains a direct damage spell that
targets all units with the Fly special rule within 24".
The target units suffer D6 Strength 6 Hits with the
Lightning Attacks special rule.
magicItems.restriction: Bound Spell, Power Level 5. One use only.

magicItems.name: Esoteric Warp Resonator
magicItems.description:
Clan Skryre only. The bearer of this item adds a free
Power dice to their casting attempt whenever they
attempt to cast the Warp Lightning spell from the Lore
of Ruin.

magicItems.name: Eye Of The Horned Rat
magicItems.description:
The Eye of the Horned Rat may be used at the start of
your Magic Phase. Roll a D6, on a 2+, add one dice to
your power dice pool. On 1, remove one dice from
your power dice pool.

magicItems.name: Scrying Stone
magicItems.description:
One use only. The bearer of the Scrying Stone gains a
2+ Ward save against their first wounding Hit suffered.
However, if this Wound is saved the model gains the
Stupidity rule for the remainder of the game.

magicItems.name: Brass Orb
magicItems.description:
Clan Skryre only. One use only. The bearer can throw
the Brass Orb in the Shooting phase. Place the small
round template with its centre anywhere within 6" of
the character and in his line of sight. The template then
scatters D3". Models touched by the template must roll
a D6 per Wound on their profile - for each roll of a 4+
they suffer a Wound which Ignores Armour Saves and
Regeneration. This has the Magical Attacks special
rule. If a 1 is rolled, centre the template on the model
throwing the globe.

magicItems.name: Bilious Bell
magicItems.description:
Clan Pestilens only. One use only. This item can be
used at the start of any of your turns. When used, all
enemy units within 18" of the bearer of this item suffer
a Strength 3 Hit, enemy units within 12" suffer D3
Strength 4 Hits and enemy units within 6" suffer D6
Strength 5 Hits.

magicItems.name: The Cube Of Mists
magicItems.description:
Clan Eshin only. One use only. This item can be used at
the start of any round of close combat. Once used, no
enemy models can make Supporting Attack this round.
In addition, all enemy models in the unit suffer -1 To
Hit.

magicItems.name: Doomrocket
magicItems.description:
Clan Skryre only. One use only. A Doomrocket is a
Rocket Launcher with the following profile:
Range: Strength: Special Rules:
12-36" 5 Slow to Fire
In case a Misfire is rolled, roll a D6 and consult the
Doomrocket Misfire chart.
DOOMROCKET MISFIRE CHART
D6 Result:
1 Thoooooom: Place the template over the model
that fired the rocket and resolve the blast as
normal.
2-5 Stabilising Fin Lost: The template scatters
3D6" from its original position. Resolve any
hits as normal.
6 It's a Dud: Resolve the shot as normal, but do
not place the template. Any model directly
below the impact spot suffers a single Strength
5 hit.

magicItems.name: Fleshgift Vial
magicItems.description:
Clan Moulder only. One use only. This item can be
used at the start of any Close Combat phase. Roll a D6
and consult the table below:
D6 Result
1 The bearer suffers 1 Wound with no saves
allowed.
2-4 One enemy unit in base contact suffer D3
Wounds with no saves allowed.
5-6 One enemy unit in base contact suffer D6
Wounds with no saves allowed.

magicItems.name: Infernal Bomb
magicItems.description:
Clan Eshin only. One use only. As long as they are not
Hidden, the bearer can place an Infernal Bomb
anywhere along their Movement path during the
Remaining Movement phase. Place a marker where the
bomb is placed. You may choose to detonate the bomb
at the start of any Movement sub-phase by rolling a
D6. On a roll of 1, nothing happens. On a 2+, the bomb
will explode; place the large round template centred on
the marker. Any model at the template's centre takes a
single Strength 10 Hit with the Multiple Wounds (D6)
special rule. Any models touched by the template suffer
a Strength 3 hit with the Armour Piercing (1) special
rule.

magicItems.name: Skalm
magicItems.description:
One use only. Skalm can be used at the beginning of
any phase in either player's turn. The bearer recovers
all Wounds suffered up to that point in the battle.

magicItems.name: Screechskull Trophies
magicItems.description:
All enemy units within 6" of the bearer of this item
must roll an additional D6 when taking Leadership
tests and discard the lowest result.

magicItems.name: Skavenbrew
magicItems.description:
One use only. This item can be used at the start of the
game. Skavenbrew affects all rank-and-file models in
the unit. Roll a D6 and consult the table below:
D6 Result
1 Gone Bad: The unit takes D6 Strength 3
automatic hits with the Ignores Armour save
special rule. The Skavenbrew has no
additional effect.
2-3 Inspired Hatred: The unit gains the Hatred
special rule.
4-5 Frenzied: The unit gains the Frenzy special
rule.
6 Rabid: The unit gains the Frenzy and Hatred
special rules. At the start of each of your
subsequent turns, the unit suffers D6
automatic Wounds.

magicItems.name: Death Globe
magicItems.description:
Clan Skryre only. One use only. Place the small round
template with its centre anywhere within 6" of the
character and in his line of sight. The template then
scatters D3". All models touched by the template must
pass a Toughness test or suffer a Wound with the
Ignores Armour Saves and Magical Attacks special
rules. If a 1 is rolled, centre the template on the model
throwing the globe.

magicItems.name: Pipes Of Piebald
magicItems.description:
All enemy units within 12" of the bearer of the Pipes of
Piebald are subject to the Stupidity special rule.

magicItems.name: Skryre'S-Breath Bellows
magicItems.description:
Clan Skryre only. One use only. This is a Breath
Weapon Attack. Any model Hit must take a Toughness
test or suffer a Wound which Ignores Armour saves.

magicItems.name: Blistrevous, The Living Cyst
magicItems.description:
Clan Pestilens only. The bearer of this item gains the
Frenzy and Hatred special rules. At the start of your
second turn and onward, if you have any friendly Clan
Pestilens character within 12" of the bearer, this item
gets transferred to them instead.

magicItems.name: Flaypelt Cloak
magicItems.description:
The bearer of this item may re-roll 1's To Hit and To
Wound in Close Combat.

magicItems.name: Gnawbomb
magicItems.description:
Clan Eshin only. One use only. This item can be used at
the start of any of your turns. When used, remove the
bearer of this item and any unit they are with, but place
a marker where the bearer was. In the Remaining
Moves sub-phase of this turn, place the unit anywhere
within 3D6" of the marker, just like a summoning
spell.

magicItems.name: Portents Of Verminous Doom
magicItems.description:
The Portents of Verminous Doom give the bearer the
Fear special rule.

magicItems.name: Rabid Crown
magicItems.description:
Clan Moulder only. All friendly Clan Moulder units
(except characters) within 6" of the bearer of this item
may re-roll failed rolls To Wound.

magicItems.name: Snoutgrovel Robes
magicItems.description:
All friendly units within 12" of the bearer of this item
gain the Immunity (Fear) special rule.

magicItems.name: Farskitter Cloak
magicItems.description:
Clan Eshin only. Bound spell, Power Level 3. This item
contains the Skitterleap spell from the Lore of Stealth.
It can only be cast on the bearer of this item.

magicItems.name: Assassins-Bane Rigging
magicItems.description:
Clan Eshin only. All enemy models that Attack this
bearer of this item in close combat suffer a Strength 3
Hit for each Hit they inflict on the bearer.

magicItems.name: Rat-Tail Snake
magicItems.description:
Clan Moulder only. If an enemy model rolls a 6's To
Hit against the bearer of this item, they immediately
suffer a Strength 4 Hit.

magicItems.name: Warpstone Charm
magicItems.description:
One use only. The Warpstone Charm allows the bearer
to re-roll any one single dice roll that directly affects
them.

magicItems.name: Vial Of The Fulminator
magicItems.description:
Clan Skryre only. At the start of each of your
Remaining Moves sub-phases, you may pick one
friendly War Machine within 12" of the bearer. This
War Machine may march this turn or move and shoot.
However, if they do so, all remaining crew must pass a
Toughness test or suffer a Wound with no saves
allowed.

magicItems.name: Sacred Standard Of The Horned Rat
magicItems.description:
All enemy units within 12" of this standard suffer a -1
penalty to their Leadership and enemy units in base
contact with the bearer of this banner must re-roll any
successful Leadership tests.

magicItems.name: Storm Banner
magicItems.description:
One use only.Tthis standard can be activated at the
beginning of any player's turn. Within 24" of this
standard, no model may use the Fly special rule and
units are at -2 to be Hit with non-magical missile
attacks. All non-magical missile attacks that do not use
Ballistics Skill to hit need to roll a 4+ on a D6 before
they can attempt to fire if they are within 24" of the
banner. Roll a D6 at the beginning of each following
player turn - the effects of the banner will end on a D6
roll of 4+.

magicItems.name: Umbranner
magicItems.description:
The unit carrying this standard gains a 4+ Ward save
against non-magical missiles with Strength 4 or less.

magicItems.name: Grand Banner Of Clan Superiority
magicItems.description:
The unit carrying this standard gains +D3 combat
resolution bonus if they have more ranks than each
enemy unit in base contact.

magicItems.name: Banner Of Burning Hatred
magicItems.description:
The unit carrying this standard gains the Hatred special
rule.

magicItems.name: Plague Banner
magicItems.description:
Plague Monks only. One use only. This standard may
be activated at the start of any Close Combat phase.
For the remainder of the phase all Plague Monk models
in the unit may re-roll failed To Hit rolls and failed To
Wound rolls.

magicItems.name: Shroud Of Dripping Death
magicItems.description:
Clan Pestilens only. This standard causes all enemy
models in base contact with the unit carrying it to
suffer a Strength 2 Hit which Ignores Armour Saves at
the start of every Close Combat phase.

magicItems.name: Banner Of The Under-Empire
magicItems.description:
This standard causes all enemy units in base contact
with the unit carrying it to suffer 3D6 Strength 1 Hits at
the start of every Close Combat phase.

magicItems.name: Dwarf-Hide Banner
magicItems.description:
The unit carrying this standard gains the Hatred special
rule against all units from Warhammer: Dwarfs.

magicItems.name: Banner Of The Swarm
magicItems.description:
The unit carrying this standard gains +2 to their combat
resolution bonus from outnumbering their enemies,
rather than +1.

magicItems.name: Banner Of The Four Black Winds
magicItems.description:
Enemies cannot use the Fly special rule to charge the
unit carrying this standard.

magicItems.name: Banner Of Verminous Scurrying
magicItems.description:
The unit carrying this standard can march three times
their Movement value. However, if they do so, the unit
suffers 2D6 Strength 3 Hits with no saves allowed after
making their March move.

loresOfMagic.name: Ruin
loresOfMagic.attribute:
Whenever a spell from the Lore of Ruin is successfully
cast, all enemy units within 6" of the caster suffer -1 to
their Leadership (to a minimum of 1) until the start of
the caster's next magic phase.
WARP LIGHTNING
Signature spell Cast on 5+
Warp Lightning is a magic missile with a range of 24"
that causes D3 Strength 5 hits with the Lightning
Attacks special rule. If the number of hits rolled is a
natural 1 (using a D6), then the caster suffers a
Strength 5 hit instead of the target.
